items.detail: Listed questionable with a sore and inflamed right elbow; tonight is the first game of a back-to-back and Heavy's preview suggests he is more likely to sit for rest.
Questionable for lower-back injury management on the first night of a back-to-back; Heavy's preview points to rest as the likelier reason he could sit.

Probable with a right hip impingement after leaving the Rockets win early; he must pass a pregame re-evaluation, and if he sits Bobby Portis is expected to take the bulk of his minutes (would raise Giannis's frontcourt load).
No injury, but his role has shrunk: he played only three fourth-quarter minutes Monday with four points and six turnovers and is 4-of-15 over his last two games — context for his assists prop.
